name: Potion of Night Vision
effect: Night Vision - see in complete darkness
uses: Ocean monument raiding without a conduit
Caving without torches - mobs still spawn, so stay alert
Exploring the deep dark without triggering shriekers by torch light
variants: Extended (8:00) with redstone dust. Splash and lingering versions exist for sharing with teammates.
editionNote: Identical in Java and Bedrock. The last seconds of Night Vision flash the screen as a warning.
keywords: night vision potion golden carrot see dark brewing

name: Potion of Invisibility
effect: Invisibility - mobs and players cannot see you (armor and held items still show)
recipe: Potion of Night Vision + fermented spider eye
uses: Sneaking past the warden - invisibility plus crouching makes you nearly undetectable
PvP ambushes and escapes
Walking through mob-infested areas safely
variants: Extended (8:00) with redstone. Splash lets you turn pets or teammates invisible.
editionNote: Identical in Java and Bedrock. Worn armor stays visible: in Java mobs detect armored invisible players from closer ranges; going unarmored is the stealth play.
keywords: invisibility potion sneak warden fermented spider eye

name: Potion of Swiftness
uses: Long overland trips before you own an elytra
Outrunning raid waves and the warden
Speed bridging and parkour practice
variants: Extended with redstone, amplified to Swiftness II (40% faster) with glowstone. Splash for horses and teammates.
editionNote: Identical in Java and Bedrock. Speed also increases jump distance and knockback taken, so watch cliffs.
keywords: swiftness speed potion sugar fast run brewing

name: Potion of Slowness
recipe: Potion of Swiftness or Leaping + fermented spider eye
base: Brewed by corrupting Swiftness or Leaping
uses: Splash it on charging ravagers and vindicators to control a raid
Slowing the warden's approach while you escape
PvP: a slowed enemy cannot close distance or retreat
variants: Extended (4:00) with redstone; glowstone corrupts to Slowness IV (0:20, 60% slower). Mainly used as splash or arrows.
editionNote: Identical in Java and Bedrock. Tipped arrows of Slowness are a strong raid and PvP tool.
keywords: slowness potion splash slow enemy raid pvp

name: Potion of Leaping
effect: Jump Boost - jump higher (half a block more per level) and take less fall damage
uses: Jumping straight over fences and 1.5-block walls
Mountain travel and ravine escapes
Combined with Slow Falling for safe big jumps
variants: Extended (8:00) with redstone, Leaping II (2.5-block jumps) with glowstone.
editionNote: Identical in Java and Bedrock. Each level also reduces fall damage by one level's worth of height.
keywords: leaping jump boost potion rabbit foot jump higher

name: Potion of Fire Resistance
effect: Fire Resistance - immunity to fire, lava, blaze fireballs and magma blocks
uses: Nether exploration and ancient debris mining - the single most important potion for the Nether
Fighting blazes and the dragon's fireballs
Swimming in lava lakes to safety
variants: Extended (8:00) with redstone. Splash for panic saves and pets.
editionNote: Identical in Java and Bedrock. Full fire immunity: lava, fire, campfire, magma blocks and blaze fireballs. It does not protect against the void or drowning.
keywords: fire resistance potion lava nether magma cream immune

name: Potion of Water Breathing
effect: Water Breathing - your oxygen bar never depletes
uses: Ocean monument raids before you own a conduit
Underwater building and shipwreck looting
Draining projects and coral reef harvesting
variants: Extended (8:00) with redstone. Splash keeps pets and teammates underwater with you.
editionNote: Identical in Java and Bedrock. Pair with Depth Strider boots and Aqua Affinity helmet for full underwater mobility.
keywords: water breathing potion pufferfish ocean monument underwater oxygen

name: Potion of Healing
effect: Instant Health - restores 4 HP (2 hearts) instantly
duration: Instant (Healing II restores 8 HP with glowstone)
uses: Panic healing in boss fights - instant, unlike regeneration
Splash it on the iron golems defending you in a raid
Harming undead: splash Healing damages zombies and skeletons
variants: Healing II with glowstone (no extended version - instant effects have no duration).
editionNote: Identical in Java and Bedrock. Instant Health heals living mobs but HARMS undead mobs - the same splash potion does both jobs.
keywords: healing potion instant health glistering melon undead damage

name: Potion of Harming
effect: Instant Damage - deals 6 HP (3 hearts) instantly
duration: Instant (Harming II deals 12 HP with glowstone)
recipe: Potion of Healing or Poison + fermented spider eye
base: Brewed by corrupting Healing or Poison
uses: Splash damage that ignores armor - the anti-player potion
Finishing low-health mobs instantly
Arrows of Harming for a strong PvP loadout
variants: Harming II with glowstone. Instant effects cannot be extended.
editionNote: Identical in Java and Bedrock. Instant Damage HEALS undead mobs - never throw Harming at zombies or the wither.
keywords: harming potion instant damage splash pvp arrows

name: Potion of Poison
effect: Poison - drains health over time, down to 1 HP (cannot kill)
uses: Splash poison on witches and pillagers in a raid, then finish them with a sword
Weakening cave spiders before they reach you
Tipped arrows of Poison for area denial
variants: Extended (1:30) with redstone, Poison II (faster drain, 0:21.6) with glowstone.
editionNote: Identical in Java and Bedrock. Poison drains health to 1 HP and stops - it can never kill, so you always need a finishing hit. Undead mobs are immune.
keywords: poison potion spider eye splash damage over time arrows

name: Potion of Regeneration
effect: Regeneration - restore health continuously (about 1 heart every 2.5 seconds at level I)
uses: Wither and dragon fights - sustain through chip damage
Raid survival between waves
Recovery after the Wither effect wears off
variants: Extended (1:30) with redstone, Regeneration II (double speed, half duration) with glowstone.
editionNote: Identical in Java and Bedrock. Ghast tears are the bottleneck: farm ghasts in soul sand valleys with Looting III.
keywords: regeneration potion ghast tear heal over time boss fight

name: Potion of Strength
effect: Strength - more melee damage (Java: +3 hearts per level; Bedrock: +30% per level)
uses: Wither and ender dragon fights - the boss standard
Two-shotting raid vindicators with a Smite V axe
Any melee-heavy situation
variants: Extended (8:00) with redstone, Strength II (1:30) with glowstone.
editionNote: BIG edition difference: Java gives a flat +3 damage per level (since 1.9), while Bedrock multiplies total damage by +30% per level - Strength II on a crit-hitting netherite sword hits far harder in Bedrock.
keywords: strength potion blaze powder melee damage boss wither

name: Potion of Weakness
recipe: Water bottle + fermented spider eye (NO nether wart needed)
base: Water Bottle directly - the only useful potion that skips the Awkward stage
uses: Curing zombie villagers: splash Weakness + golden apple starts the conversion - the foundation of every trading hall
Nerfing a ravager or vindicator's melee in a pinch
PvP support splash
variants: Extended (4:00) with redstone. No level II.
editionNote: Identical in Java and Bedrock: fermented spider eye straight into a water bottle. Keep a chest of these ready whenever a zombie villager appears.
keywords: weakness potion cure zombie villager golden apple fermented spider eye

name: Potion of the Turtle Master
effect: Slowness IV + Resistance III - nearly unkillable but very slow
duration: 0:20 (0:40 extended; Turtle Master II gives Resistance IV with glowstone)
uses: Tanking the warden's melee while a teammate attacks
Surviving a ravager charge or a creeper point-blank
Holding a choke point in PvP
variants: Extended (0:40) with redstone; Turtle Master II (Resistance IV, Slowness VI) with glowstone.
editionNote: Identical in Java and Bedrock. Turtle scutes come from baby turtles growing up - breed turtles on beaches with seagrass to farm them.
keywords: turtle master potion resistance tank scute slow

name: Potion of Slow Falling
effect: Slow Falling - fall gently, take no fall damage, land softly like a glider
uses: The End: bridging between islands without fear of falling off
Jumping off mountains and build sites safely
Dodging shulker levitation - slow falling overrides the float
variants: Extended (4:00) with redstone. No level II.
editionNote: Identical in Java and Bedrock. Phantom membranes come from phantoms (they spawn after three sleepless nights) and occasionally from cat gifts.
keywords: slow falling potion phantom membrane no fall damage end shulker

name: Potion of Wind Charging
effect: Wind Charged - the affected entity releases a wind burst when it dies
uses: Splash on a mob you are about to kill for a free knockback burst
Wind-burst mobility tricks: kill a charged mob under you to launch yourself
Pranks and mob-launch contraptions
variants: No extended or level II version. Splash and lingering only.
editionNote: Identical in Java and Bedrock since 1.21. The wind burst works like a wind charge explosion - knocks entities and activates buttons and doors.
keywords: wind charging potion breeze rod wind charged burst trial chambers

name: Potion of Oozing
effect: Oozing - the affected entity spawns two medium slimes when it dies
uses: Slimeball farming: splash a mob, kill it, harvest the slimes
Chaos in PvP arenas
Pairing with a looting sword for maximum slime drops
variants: No extended or level II version. Splash and lingering only.
editionNote: Identical in Java and Bedrock since 1.21. The spawned slimes are medium size, so they split once more when killed - a real slimeball multiplier.
keywords: oozing potion slime block slimes death effect 1.21

name: Potion of Weaving
effect: Weaving - the affected entity moves 50% faster through cobwebs and spawns 2-3 cobwebs on death
uses: Traps: splash a mob, kill it, and its death webs slow the next wave
Cobweb generation for string farms
Mob-arena mayhem
variants: No extended or level II version. Splash and lingering only.
editionNote: Identical in Java and Bedrock since 1.21. Cobwebs drop string when broken with a sword or shears, so weaving kills feed string production.
keywords: weaving potion cobweb spiders death webs 1.21

name: Potion of Infestation
effect: Infested - the affected entity has a 10% chance to spawn 1-2 silverfish when hit
recipe: Awkward Potion + stone block (yes, plain stone)
uses: Silverfish XP and monster-farming tricks
Area chaos in mob arenas
Mostly a novelty for farms and fun - it has little practical survival use
variants: No extended or level II version. Splash and lingering only.
editionNote: Identical in Java and Bedrock since 1.21. It is the only potion brewed with a full block of stone as the ingredient.
